thread:
Evan: Quick lightning checklist for OKR writeups. Need 6 lines max, copy/paste-ready.
Harper: Love that. Keep it usable for ICs and managers.
Evan: Proposed 6-line format: 1) One-line goal. 2) Outcome metric + target. 3) Business impact (1 phrase). 4) Key milestone this quarter. 5) Top risk. 6) Ask (owner/time).
Zoe: Example (ML infra): 'Goal: Ship adaptive batching for online inference to reduce average token cost. Metric-> cost per 1k tokens -18% vs baseline by EOM. Impact-> lowers customer cost and improves margins. Milestone-> end-to-end canary on dev traffic. Risk-> cache invalidation edge cases. Ask-> 2w SRE pairing for canary.'
Ravi: Manager variant (skip-level friendly): 'Led delivery of X that moved Y by N%; planning to scale via A; blockers: B; need: C.'
Harper: Self-review micro-line: 'Delivered X -> Y outcome; biggest learning: Z; next: A.'
Evan: Tiny coaching prompts to add to checklist: 'What minimal signal proves we're on track?', 'If it fails, what's the rollback?', 'Who owns the cross-team sync?'.
People Ops Bot: Saved to drive -> https://drive.redwood/okrs/lightning-checklist (team read).
Zoe: I'll add a non-technical external wording for execs and customer comms.
Harper: Can you also add examples for hiring and onboarding OKRs? small ones like 'Reduce time-to-first-PR to 14 days'.
Evan: Will add and push to handbook later today. Closing thread. :sparkles:
